articles.title: Wife Catches Husband With Alleged Girlfriend Near Agra Hotel
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic confrontation unfolded in Uttar Pradesh's Agra district after a woman allegedly caught her husband with another woman near a hotel, leading to a heated roadside altercation that was captured on video and later went viral on social media.

body.html:
A dramatic confrontation unfolded in Uttar Pradesh's Agra district after a woman allegedly caught her husband with another woman near a hotel, leading to a heated roadside altercation that was captured on video and later went viral on social media.

The incident reportedly took place behind TDI Mall in the Tajganj police station area.

According to local reports, the woman spotted her husband in the company of his alleged girlfriend and immediately confronted him. The argument soon escalated, with the wife first verbally confronting her husband before turning her attention to the other woman.

Eyewitnesses said a physical fight broke out between the two women in the middle of the road. During the altercation, both women allegedly exchanged abuses and engaged in a scuffle that drew the attention of passersby.

The situation intensified when the wife allegedly threw the other woman's scooter onto the road. Videos circulating on social media show a crowd gathering at the scene as the confrontation continued.

During the scuffle, one of the women's clothes was reportedly torn. The viral footage also allegedly shows the other woman picking up a brick from the roadside in an apparent attempt to defend herself.

The husband, caught in the middle of the confrontation, was seen trying to separate the two and calm the situation. However, the argument continued for some time before the women were eventually separated.

Several bystanders recorded the incident on their mobile phones instead of intervening, and the videos have since spread widely across social media platforms.

Police have not yet released an official statement regarding the incident, and it remains unclear whether any formal complaint has been filed by either party.

Further details are awaited.

articles.title: Couple Allegedly Kills Lover, Dismembers Body and Burns It in Forest
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A chilling murder case has come to light from Uttar Pradesh's Fatehpur district, where a husband and wife were arrested for allegedly murdering a man over an extramarital affair, dismembering his body and attempting to destroy evidence by burning the remains in a forest.

body.html:
A chilling murder case has come to light from Uttar Pradesh's Fatehpur district, where a husband and wife were arrested for allegedly murdering a man over an extramarital affair, dismembering his body and attempting to destroy evidence by burning the remains in a forest.

Police said the accused, Kamta Prasad Nishad and his wife Kiran Devi, were arrested after an investigation into the disappearance of Vijay Nishad, a labourer from Tikra village.

According to investigators, Vijay frequently travelled to Hamirpur for work and had allegedly been involved in a relationship with Kiran Devi for about a year. Kiran's husband, Kamta Prasad, who worked in Gujarat, reportedly learned about the affair through relatives and returned to his village after opposing the relationship.

Police said the couple then allegedly conspired to eliminate Vijay.

According to the investigation, on May 8, Kiran allegedly called Vijay and invited him to her house, reportedly telling him that her husband was away. When Vijay arrived on his motorcycle, Kiran allegedly let him inside and locked the door.

Police claim that Kamta Prasad, who was already present inside the house, attacked Vijay with a wooden door frame and repeatedly struck him on the head, killing him on the spot.

Investigators allege that after the murder, the couple attempted to conceal the crime by dismembering the body using cutting tools and later transporting the remains to a forest area in Kanpur, where they set them on fire. However, the body was not completely burnt.

The case came to light after Vijay's father, Indrapal Nishad, filed a missing person report on May 11. During the investigation, police traced Vijay's mobile phone records and found frequent communication between him and Kiran Devi.

Officials said Kiran became nervous when contacted by investigators, raising suspicion. Police subsequently detained and questioned the couple, who allegedly confessed to the crime during interrogation.

According to police, the accused also searched online for information related to murder cases, including punishments under Section 302 and ways to avoid legal consequences after committing the crime.

Based on information provided by the accused, police recovered Vijay's motorcycle, ATM card, PAN card, the wooden object allegedly used in the murder and a half-burnt body from a forest area in Kanpur. The remains have been sent for post-mortem examination.

Superintendent of Police Abhimanyu Manglik said the investigation revealed that the murder was linked to the alleged affair and longstanding tensions between the victim and the accused couple.

A case has been registered and further investigation is underway.

#Fatehpur #UttarPradesh #CrimeNews #MurderCase #LoveAffair

articles.title: ‘No Child in 12 Years’: Hapur Woman Alleges Brutal Torture by In-Laws
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case of alleged domestic violence has surfaced from the Garh Kotwali area of Uttar Pradesh's Hapur district, where a woman has accused her husband and in-laws of subjecting her to years of abuse for not having a child even after 12 years of marriage.

body.html:
A disturbing case of alleged domestic violence has surfaced from the Garh Kotwali area of Uttar Pradesh's Hapur district, where a woman has accused her husband and in-laws of subjecting her to years of abuse for not having a child even after 12 years of marriage.

The victim has alleged that she was confined to a room for several days, denied food and brutally assaulted by her in-laws. After enduring years of alleged harassment, she has now approached the police seeking justice and protection.

The case gained attention after CCTV footage purportedly showing the assault surfaced on social media and went viral. The footage, reportedly captured by a camera installed inside the house, allegedly shows the woman's husband physically assaulting her while other family members remain present at the scene.

According to the victim, she has been facing harassment since her marriage due to her inability to conceive. She alleged that her in-laws repeatedly taunted and abused her over the issue and that the recent incident amounted to an attempt on her life.

Accompanied by her parents, the woman spoke to the media and detailed her ordeal. She claimed that she is regularly threatened by her husband and in-laws, who allegedly warn her that both she and her parents could be harmed.

The victim further alleged that her husband frequently consumes alcohol and drives while intoxicated. She claimed that his behaviour has previously led to a serious accident.

Following the incident, the woman lodged a formal complaint with the local police and demanded strict action against those responsible. She has also sought protection, alleging that she fears for her safety.

Police have received the complaint and are examining the allegations along with the viral CCTV footage. Further investigation into the matter is underway.

The incident has sparked widespread outrage on social media, with many calling for strict action against those accused of subjecting the woman to prolonged abuse and violence.

#Hapur #DomesticViolence #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #CCTVFootage

articles.title: Midnight Photoshoot in Uniform? Viral Video of Woman Constable on Car Bonnet Triggers Probe
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video purportedly showing a woman police constable posing for a photoshoot and allegedly performing stunts on the bonnet of a car in Lalitpur has gone viral on social media, prompting an official inquiry.

body.html:
A video purportedly showing a woman police constable posing for a photoshoot and allegedly performing stunts on the bonnet of a car in Lalitpur has gone viral on social media, prompting an official inquiry.

The incident reportedly took place near B Market on Station Road in Lalitpur around midnight. According to claims circulating online, the woman constable was in police uniform when the video was recorded in the middle of the road.

The viral footage allegedly shows the constable sitting and posing on the bonnet of a four-wheeler while photographs and videos were being taken. The video quickly gained attention on social media, triggering widespread discussion and mixed reactions from users.

According to reports, the woman constable was seen moving away from the spot after noticing that she was being filmed. There are also allegations that attempts were made to stop the person recording the video.

Following the circulation of the footage, senior police officials took cognisance of the matter and ordered an investigation.

Lalitpur Police stated that the incident is reported to have occurred near B Market on Station Road. The Inspector In-charge of Lalitpur Police Station has been directed to conduct a detailed inquiry and take necessary action based on the findings.

Police have not yet released the outcome of the investigation or confirmed the exact circumstances surrounding the viral video.

Further action, if any, will depend on the findings of the ongoing inquiry.

articles.title: UP Constable Suspended After Viral Audio of Alleged Abuse Against Woman
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A constable posted with UP-112 in Uttar Pradesh's Auraiya district has been suspended after an audio clip allegedly capturing him abusing and misbehaving with a young woman over the phone went viral on social media.

body.html:
A constable posted with UP-112 in Uttar Pradesh's Auraiya district has been suspended after an audio clip allegedly capturing him abusing and misbehaving with a young woman over the phone went viral on social media.

The action was taken after Superintendent of Police Abhishek Bharti took cognisance of the viral audio and ordered a departmental inquiry into the matter.

According to the allegations, the incident occurred when Head Constable Rajendra Singh contacted a young woman late at night regarding a complaint. During the call, he allegedly informed her that her complaint had been registered and then insisted that she hand over the phone to her mother.

The woman reportedly told the constable that her mother was asleep and requested that the conversation be continued in the morning. However, the constable allegedly refused and continued pressuring her.

The viral audio purportedly captures the policeman using abusive language and making objectionable remarks during a prolonged argument with the woman. The conversation was reportedly recorded and later circulated widely on social media, triggering outrage and drawing the attention of senior police officials.

Following the circulation of the audio clip, Additional Superintendent of Police Alok Mishra conducted a preliminary inquiry into the matter. According to officials, the initial investigation confirmed that the voice heard in the recording appeared to be that of Head Constable Rajendra Singh, who was posted with UP-112.

Based on the preliminary findings, a report was submitted to the Superintendent of Police. Acting on the report, SP Abhishek Bharti ordered the immediate suspension of the accused constable and directed that a departmental inquiry be conducted.

ASP Alok Mishra confirmed that disciplinary proceedings have been initiated and that the matter is being investigated in detail.

Police officials stated that if the allegations are found to be true during the inquiry, strict departmental action will be taken against the accused constable.

The incident has sparked widespread criticism on social media and raised concerns over the conduct of police personnel while interacting with complainants, particularly women.

#Auraiya #UPPolice #ViralAudio #PoliceMisconduct #BreakingNews

articles.title: Youths on Bike Throw Water Bottles at Women Devotees During Parikrama,
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident has come to light from Vrindavan in Uttar Pradesh's Mathura district, where two youths allegedly misbehaved with young women performing the Parikrama by throwing water bottles at them while riding a motorcycle.

body.html:
A disturbing incident has come to light from Vrindavan in Uttar Pradesh's Mathura district, where two youths allegedly misbehaved with young women performing the Parikrama by throwing water bottles at them while riding a motorcycle.

The incident was recorded on video by another group of youths riding behind the accused, and the footage later went viral on social media, prompting police action.

According to reports, a large number of devotees have been arriving in Vrindavan to perform the Parikrama during the ongoing Purushottam month. Amid the heavy rush of pilgrims, two youths riding a motorcycle allegedly targeted young women walking on the Parikrama route and threw water bottles at them.

The entire act was captured on camera by another youth travelling behind them on a motorcycle. After witnessing the incident, the individuals recording the video reportedly stopped the accused and reprimanded them for their behaviour.

The viral video has triggered widespread criticism on social media, with many demanding strict action against those involved.

Taking cognisance of the video, Vrindavan Police have launched an investigation and begun efforts to identify the accused. Police officials said the youths seen in the footage are being traced and that strict legal action will be taken once they are identified.

Authorities have appealed to the public to maintain decorum and respect religious devotees visiting the holy town. Further investigation into the matter is underway.

#Vrindavan #Mathura #ViralVideo #Parikrama #WomenSafety

articles.title: Exam Day Turns Into Nightmare: Drain Cover Collapses, B.Ed Aspirants Fall Into Sewer in Kanpur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Several candidates appearing for the B.Ed entrance examination were injured after a drain cover suddenly collapsed beneath them outside a photocopy shop in Kanpur's Colonelganj area on Saturday.

body.html:
Several candidates appearing for the B.Ed entrance examination were injured after a drain cover suddenly collapsed beneath them outside a photocopy shop in Kanpur's Colonelganj area on Saturday.

According to eyewitnesses, more than two dozen candidates had gathered outside the shop to get their documents photocopied and complete last-minute preparations before the examination. The students were standing on a stone slab covering a drain when it suddenly gave way.

As the slab collapsed, several candidates fell into the drain, triggering panic among those present at the spot.

Local residents, shopkeepers and bystanders immediately rushed to help and pulled the students out of the drain. Several candidates sustained injuries in the incident, although the exact number of injured students was not immediately known.

Videos from the scene showed chaotic moments as people carried out rescue efforts and assisted the injured candidates.

The incident occurred in the Colonelganj police station area, where a large number of aspirants had assembled ahead of the B.Ed entrance examination.

Police and local authorities were informed about the incident and further details regarding the condition of the injured students are awaited.

The incident has raised serious concerns over civic infrastructure and public safety arrangements, especially in areas that witness large crowds during competitive examinations and other public events.

#Kanpur #BEdEntranceExam #BreakingNews #Colonelganj #ViralVideo

articles.title: Chaos at Bhiwadi Spa Centre: Viral Video Shows Three Women Assaulting Youth
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video showing three young women allegedly assaulting a young man outside a spa centre in Bhiwadi's Royal Plaza Shopping Complex has gone viral on social media, drawing attention to ongoing concerns about activities at spa centres operating in the area.

body.html:
A video showing three young women allegedly assaulting a young man outside a spa centre in Bhiwadi's Royal Plaza Shopping Complex has gone viral on social media, drawing attention to ongoing concerns about activities at spa centres operating in the area.

The incident reportedly took place around 3 pm on May 26 on the third floor of the Royal Plaza Shopping Complex located on the Bhiwadi Bypass.

In the viral video, three women can be seen allegedly beating the young man, tearing his clothes and striking him with a wiper. The reason behind the altercation has not yet been officially confirmed. No police complaint has been filed by the youth so far.

Royal Plaza President Vinod Yadav alleged that the growing number of spa centres in the complex is adversely affecting other businesses. He said there are 104 shops in the complex, of which eight are currently operating as spa centres.

According to Yadav, these establishments remain crowded throughout the day, making it difficult for regular shopkeepers to sustain their businesses. He claimed that despite repeatedly submitting written complaints to the Bhiwadi Superintendent of Police and Tijara MLA Mahant Baba Balak Nath, no effective action has been taken.

Yadav further alleged that a police team was formed to investigate complaints, but no concrete results emerged. He claimed that since the complaints were raised, the number of spa centres in the complex has increased from four to eight. He also levelled allegations of police collusion.

Dr Manjeet Sharma, who operates a dental clinic in Royal Plaza, also expressed concern over the atmosphere in the complex. He alleged that large numbers of visitors frequent the spa centres throughout the day, affecting the environment for businesses and customers.

According to Dr Sharma, more than 100 spa centres are allegedly operating illegally across various locations in Bhiwadi, including Royal Plaza, Genesis Mall, Capital Mall and several residential societies. He claimed that authorities are aware of these establishments but have not taken sufficient action.

Responding to the incident, Bhiwadi Police Station House Officer Sachin Sharma said police have not yet received any formal complaint regarding the viral video. He stated that if the victim approaches the police, a case will be registered and appropriate action will be taken.

The officer added that action has been taken against spa centres in Bhiwadi from time to time and assured that strict measures would be taken if any violation of the law is found in the present case.

Police are yet to verify the circumstances surrounding the altercation shown in the viral video.

#Bhiwadi #ViralVideo #SpaCentre #RajasthanNews #CrimeNews

articles.title: Daylight Gunfire in Prayagraj Market: History-Sheeter ‘Jailer’ Arrested After Shocking Shooting
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Prayagraj Police have arrested history-sheeter Manvendra Pratap Singh alias "Jailer" in connection with a broad daylight firing incident that triggered panic in the busy Jhunsi market area.

body.html:
Prayagraj Police have arrested history-sheeter Manvendra Pratap Singh alias "Jailer" in connection with a broad daylight firing incident that triggered panic in the busy Jhunsi market area.

The accused was taken into custody late on Saturday (30 May 2026) night following an extensive search operation conducted by police teams across Jhunsi, Sarai Inayat and other areas across the Ganga. Police have also recovered the pistol allegedly used in the incident and launched a search for the remaining accused.

According to police, the incident took place around 11:15 am on Saturday near Tiranga Chauraha (Lal Chowk) in Jhunsi. A dispute reportedly broke out between two groups and soon escalated into violence.

Police said Manvendra Pratap Singh alias Jailer, a resident of the Sarai Inayat area and a known history-sheeter, arrived at the spot in a black Mahindra Scorpio along with his associates. He allegedly assaulted Pawan Kumar alias Parvat Goswami, a resident of Housing Development Colony, Jhunsi.

According to the victim's complaint, Pawan was on his way to purchase medicines when Manvendra, along with Saurabh Singh alias Prince and two unidentified associates, intercepted him. The accused allegedly assaulted him, following which Pawan tried to flee towards his house.

Police said Manvendra then allegedly pulled out a pistol and fired two rounds in the air. The gunfire caused panic in the crowded market, forcing shopkeepers to immediately shut their shops while shoppers and pedestrians rushed to safety.

The accused allegedly fled the scene before police arrived. Officers later recovered empty cartridge cases from the spot and examined CCTV footage from nearby cameras.

Based on the victim's complaint, Jhunsi Police registered an FIR against Manvendra and four other accused. During the investigation, police teams led by Jhunsi Station House Officer Mahesh Mishra conducted multiple raids before successfully tracing and arresting the main accused.

During preliminary interrogation, Manvendra allegedly admitted to firing the shots. Police said he has 19 criminal cases registered against him. Investigators are now verifying whether the recovered pistol is licensed or illegal. Efforts are also underway to locate the black Scorpio used in the incident and arrest the remaining accused.

The victim told police that he had previously been assaulted and robbed by the accused, and that an old rivalry was behind the latest attack.

ACP Jhunsi Kunjlata confirmed that the main accused has been taken into custody and the weapon used in the firing has been recovered. Further investigation is underway.

The incident has raised concerns over the activities of habitual offenders, particularly after gunfire erupted in a crowded marketplace in broad daylight, causing fear among traders and local residents.

#Prayagraj #Jhunsi #BreakingNews #HistorySheeter #Gunfire

articles.title: Rejected Marriage Proposal Turns Deadly: Man Allegedly Kills Toddler to Pressure Mother, Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case has emerged from Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad district, where a man allegedly killed a one-and-a-half-year-old child after the child's mother rejected his repeated marriage proposals.

body.html:
A shocking case has emerged from Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad district, where a man allegedly killed a one-and-a-half-year-old child after the child's mother rejected his repeated marriage proposals.

The accused, identified as Viraj alias Jitendra Pathak, was arrested following a police encounter on Saturday evening. Police said the accused sustained bullet injuries to both legs during the operation and is currently undergoing treatment under police custody.

According to police and the victim's family, the incident took place in the Shikohabad area. The child's mother, Rati, had been living with her parents along with her son Aarav after marital disputes with her husband. Family members alleged that Viraj, a relative of her in-laws, had been pressuring her to marry him and frequently offered to help her in legal disputes with her husband. However, she repeatedly rejected his proposals.

Family members said Viraj was a frequent visitor and had gained the trust of the child by regularly taking him for walks and buying him chocolates. On Saturday afternoon, when he offered to take Aarav out for a chocolate, no one suspected any wrongdoing.

According to the complaint filed by the child's maternal grandmother, Pinky Sharma, Viraj arrived at the house where the family was visiting a relative in Yadav Colony. He took the toddler with him on the pretext of buying candy.

Police said the accused allegedly took the child to a deserted stretch of road and fatally assaulted him, causing severe head injuries. CCTV footage recovered by investigators reportedly shows the accused carrying the child and later leaving the body outside the house before fleeing.

When family members found Aarav unconscious outside the house, they rushed him to the District Joint Hospital. Doctors declared him dead on arrival. The incident triggered scenes of grief, with the child's mother and grandmother breaking down at the hospital. Hospital staff alerted the police after becoming suspicious about the circumstances of the child's injuries.

During the investigation, police examined CCTV footage from the area, which allegedly captured the sequence of events. Investigators believe the accused targeted the child because he viewed him as an obstacle to his desire to marry the victim's mother.

Rati told police that Viraj had repeatedly spoken about marrying her despite knowing she was already married and had a child. She said she allowed him to take Aarav because he was a relative and had previously earned the family's trust.

Later on Saturday, police received information about the accused's location near Bharthara turn. Officials said that when officers attempted to stop him, he allegedly opened fire. In the ensuing exchange, police shot him in both legs and took him into custody.

Police recovered a .315-bore pistol, two empty cartridges and five live cartridges from the accused. SP City Ravi Shankar Prasad said the accused is being interrogated, while CO Amrish Kumar stated that preliminary investigation indicates the accused was frustrated after his marriage proposal was rejected and allegedly believed the child stood in the way of his plans.

A case has been registered and further investigation is underway.

#Firozabad #Shikohabad #CrimeNews #UttarPradesh #CCTVFootage #BreakingNews
